title: The unopened letter
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: A letter with a streaming service's logo sits on the drafting table for four panels. Unopened.

panels.composition: The drafting table. A white envelope with a streaming service's logo in the corner — the logo drawn as a red rectangle, no name. WOOD drawing beside it. BARNABY II under the table.

image.prompt: a drafting table with a white business envelope bearing a small red rectangular logo lying beside a man's drawing hand, a three-legged dog under the table, razor-sharp ink
the same drafting table, the man still drawing, the envelope untouched, no words

panels.composition: Same. The lamp on now; it's evening. The envelope.

image.prompt: the same table in evening lamp light, the man still drawing, the envelope still untouched, no words

panels.composition: Same. The pup asleep on the envelope. Wood drawing. It stays unopened.

image.prompt: the same table at night, a three-legged dog now asleep on top of the unopened envelope while the man keeps drawing, no words
image.notes: Never opened on the page. The afterword can say what it offered.

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: The animated pitch, refused by never being opened.
